# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. The grouped learner-stage sentence on physical12 places vision and knowledge beside an accuracy figure; physical13 separately gives the vision ratio and knowledge passing standard. Do not teach a percentage-based vision score. Litter-study figures are attributed to the guide’s dated study and not asserted as current independently measured statistics. Licensing/renewal/currentness and source effective-date debts remain. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.
